authority: Yahoo Finance stock quote surfaces define SmartFund's minimum stock-data scope. This specification is the implementation authority; no stock field may be marked complete without its declared source, provenance, lifecycle and API evidence.
scope: Yahoo-listed equities including 2330.TW, AAPL, MSFT and NVDA

permanentExclusions.policy: Never fetch, cache, quote, republish, analyse or expose these content types. They are excluded for copyright, licensing and compliance reasons.

statusLegend.PARTIAL: Schema, script or API exists, but coverage or Production lifecycle is not proven for every stock.
statusLegend.NOT_BUILT: No canonical Production schema, worker and API contract exist.
statusLegend.DERIVED_NOT_BUILT: May be calculated solely from canonical data but has not been implemented.
statusLegend.CONDITIONAL: Yahoo exposes the field only for eligible securities or regions.
statusLegend.EXCLUDED: Deliberately forbidden by the permanent exclusion policy.

quoteFundamentals.note: No registered Production adapter currently exists.

corporateActions.method: Yahoo history events plus verified official-event fallback policy
corporateActions.note: Rights, symbol changes, mergers, spin-offs and delistings are not uniformly structured by Yahoo.

technical.note: No second price provider is required.

sections.historical: PARTIAL: stock_history stores OHLC, adjustedClose, volume, source, sourceSymbol and providerMethod; global coverage is tracked separately.
sections.daily: PARTIAL: Yahoo incremental Production lifecycle exists only for markets already onboarded.
sections.api: PARTIAL: /api/stocks/[symbol] and /api/stocks/[symbol]/history expose the stored fields.
sections.frequency: Intraday while Yahoo publishes; daily bars validated against Provider Latest Available.

sections.yahooAvailability: CONDITIONAL: Yahoo displays most quote statistics for eligible securities; turnover and VWAP are not universal standalone Yahoo quote fields.
sections.current: PARTIAL: Stock stores latestClose/latestDate only; no canonical quote-statistics snapshot exists.
sections.historical: NOT_BUILT for point-in-time quote-statistics history; 52-week and VWAP may be calculated from OHLCV.
sections.api: PARTIAL: latest close only; no quote-statistics contract.
sections.provider: YAHOO_QUOTE_SUMMARY (REQUIRED); SMARTFUND derivation for turnover/VWAP where definable
sections.frequency: Provider quote refresh / end-of-day snapshot; derived values follow each completed bar.
sections.otherProviderRequired: NO for Yahoo-exposed values; definition required for turnover.

fields: Yahoo chart ranges, intervals, comparisons and displayed indicators
sections.yahooAvailability: YES for interactive charting/indicator surface; field availability and parameter choices vary by Yahoo UI and security.
sections.current: PARTIAL: stock_technical schema/calculator cover SMA(5/20/60/120/240), EMA(12/26), MACD, KD, RSI14, ATR14 and Bollinger Bands; no Production API or lifecycle evidence.
sections.historical: PARTIAL for listed implemented indicators; NOT_BUILT for ADX, CCI, Williams %R, ROC, Momentum, OBV, VWAP, Beta, volatility, distance, scores, support/resistance, breakout, gap and trend direction.
sections.daily: NOT_BUILT as a Production technical recalculation lifecycle.
sections.frequency: Recalculate after each accepted Yahoo daily bar; intraday technicals require a separately approved intraday lifecycle.

sections.yahooAvailability: CONDITIONAL: Profile and statistics are normally available for covered operating companies; GICS, IPO date, float and executives vary by market/security.
sections.current: PARTIAL: Stock stores ticker, Yahoo symbol, exchange, country, currency, company name, sector and industry only.
sections.daily: NOT_BUILT; profile data needs event-driven/periodic refresh rather than market-day-only refresh.
sections.frequency: Profile/share structure: daily freshness check with change-only write; fiscal metadata: periodic/filing-event refresh.
sections.otherProviderRequired: NO for Yahoo minimum; official exchange/filing source is required only if Yahoo omits a mandatory field.

sections.yahooAvailability: CONDITIONAL: Yahoo Financials provides annual/quarterly statements for covered issuers; TTM presentation and line coverage vary by issuer/market.
sections.daily: NOT_BUILT; financial data should update on provider filing/statement refresh, not every trading day.
sections.frequency: Provider Latest Available after earnings/filing refresh; annual, quarterly and TTM versions retained separately.
sections.otherProviderRequired: NO for Yahoo minimum; official filing adapter may be needed where Yahoo has no statement coverage.

sections.yahooAvailability: CONDITIONAL: Yahoo statistics/financials/analysis expose many ratios, but market and issuer coverage varies; ROIC and Quick Ratio may require transparent SmartFund calculation.
sections.daily: NOT_BUILT; market-dependent ratios refresh with quote updates, statement-dependent ratios refresh after filings.
sections.provider: YAHOO_QUOTE_SUMMARY (REQUIRED) plus SMARTFUND calculated ratios from canonical statements/quotes
sections.frequency: Provider Latest Available; retain as-of date and calculation version.

sections.yahooAvailability: YES for dividend and split history for many Yahoo symbols; CONDITIONAL/PARTIAL for payment date and non-split corporate actions; Yahoo does not guarantee a complete structured rights/merger/spin-off/delisting feed.
sections.current: PARTIAL only through adjusted price effects; no canonical dividend/corporate-action table or API.
sections.daily: NOT_BUILT; event ingestion should be incremental and effective-date aware.
sections.provider: YAHOO_CORPORATE_ACTIONS (REQUIRED); official corporate-action provider decision needed for fields Yahoo does not structurally provide.
sections.frequency: Provider Latest Available with future announced/effective events retained separately.
sections.otherProviderRequired: YES for complete rights, symbol change, merger, spin-off and delisting coverage.

sections.yahooAvailability: CONDITIONAL: Yahoo Holders/Statistics expose selected ownership and short-interest data, mainly for covered markets; ETF-holder and insider detail are not universal.
sections.daily: NOT_BUILT; ownership data follows provider report cadence, not trading-day cadence.
sections.otherProviderRequired: NO for Yahoo minimum; official regulator/filing source required for universal coverage.

fields: ESG Risk/Ranking fields displayed by Yahoo
sections.yahooAvailability: CONDITIONAL: Yahoo Sustainability is not available for every issuer and may contain licensed/restricted datasets.
sections.daily: NOT_BUILT; refresh follows provider release cadence.
sections.otherProviderRequired: YES if Yahoo terms or coverage do not permit Production use.

sections.yahooAvailability: CONDITIONAL: Analysis data is issuer/market dependent and some Yahoo research surfaces can be subscription/licence restricted.
sections.daily: NOT_BUILT; refresh when Yahoo publishes an estimate/revision/earnings event.
sections.frequency: Provider Latest Available; preserve publication and effective dates.
sections.otherProviderRequired: YES if Yahoo terms or coverage do not permit Production use.

sections.yahooAvailability: CONDITIONAL: Yahoo Options is available only for optionable instruments and supported markets.
sections.frequency: Provider quote cadence / Provider Latest Available.
sections.otherProviderRequired: YES if Yahoo does not legally/technically support Production retrieval.

sections.historical: NOT_BUILT: score histories require point-in-time source snapshots and versioning.
sections.daily: NOT_BUILT: calculate only after source freshness/validation succeeds.
sections.provider: SMARTFUND deterministic/AI scoring with input provenance
sections.frequency: After valid price, fundamental and risk inputs; version every model/calculation.
sections.otherProviderRequired: NO, but source inputs must be available and licensed.

sections.yahooAvailability: YES on Yahoo, but permanently excluded from SmartFund.
sections.otherProviderRequired: NO: no substitute is permitted under this specification.

priorityOrder: P0: complete Yahoo price/history provenance and Production Daily across stock markets
P1: quote statistics, profile/share structure, statements, ratios, dividends/corporate actions, and full deterministic technical lifecycle
P2: ownership/short interest, ESG subject to licence review, analyst/earnings subject to licence review, then SmartFund scores
EXCLUDED: all news, articles, commentary, video, live and social/community content
acceptance: Every implemented field records provider, source symbol, as-of/effective date, imported/updated timestamp and method/version.
Daily freshness compares database latest value with Provider Latest Available, not calendar date.
Financial, ownership, ESG, analyst and corporate-event data use provider release/report cadence rather than a forced daily bar rule.
Yahoo-restricted or incomplete structured fields require an explicit legal provider decision before Production ingestion; never screen-scrape around access restrictions.
No excluded content may enter raw archives, caches, database tables, APIs, scores or logs.
